name: Chesya Neko
source:
A cat who guides Alice on behalf of the White Rabbit, who has abandoned his role as a guide. He doesn't have an owner. He always wears a hood and runs away if you try to touch his ears. He hates the White Rabbit.

[Translated from [url=http://chuclo.web.fc2.com/products/alice/index.html#chara]official website[/url]]
